title: Implement User Authentication API
description: Create the REST API endpoints for user login, logout, and token refresh with JWT-based authentication.
acceptance_criteria: POST /auth/login accepts email and password
Returns JWT access token on success
POST /auth/refresh renews expired tokens
POST /auth/logout invalidates the session

title: Create Dashboard Layout Component
description: Build the main dashboard layout with sidebar navigation and content area using the design tokens from the UI design system.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard renders with a collapsible sidebar
Sidebar shows navigation links for all sections
Content area fills remaining viewport width
Responsive layout adapts to mobile screens

title: Define API Contract for Ticket Operations
description: Write the OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the ticket CRUD endpoints, including request/response schemas and error codes.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAPI spec covers GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE for /tickets
Request schemas include validation constraints
Error responses follow RFC 7807 Problem Details
Spec passes OpenAPI linter with zero errors

title: Add Security Headers Middleware
description: Implement Express middleware that sets standard security headers: Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, and X-Content-Type-Options.
acceptance_criteria: CSP header blocks inline scripts by default
HSTS max-age is at least 1 year
X-Frame-Options set to DENY
X-Content-Type-Options set to nosniff

title: Write Database Migration Guide
description: Document the database migration workflow including how to create, test, and apply migrations in development and production environments.
acceptance_criteria: Guide covers creating a new migration
Includes rollback procedures
Documents CI integration for migration testing
Has examples for common schema changes

title: Research MCP Transport Options
description: Evaluate SSE vs WebSocket vs Streamable HTTP for the MCP server transport layer. Compare latency, complexity, and browser support.
acceptance_criteria: Comparison table with at least 3 transport options
Latency benchmarks for each option
Recommendation with justification
Risk assessment for the chosen approach

title: Implement Ticket Status Endpoint
description: Create a full-stack ticket status page with backend API and frontend component showing ticket pipeline status.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/tickets/status returns aggregated counts per stage
Frontend renders a kanban-style board
Real-time updates via SSE when ticket state changes
Supports filtering by ticket type and priority
